parts.label: Liquid refractive index relative to the atmosphere
parts.help: Spherical droplets. Atmosphere index taken as one. Solve stationary primary deviation at an antisolar radius of 49°. Tolerance ±0.003.

parts.label: Secondary antisolar angular radius
parts.help: Use the index inferred in part (a), not a generic terrestrial index. This branch lies inside the 49° primary bow. Tolerance ±0.1°.

parts.label: Relative position diagram
parts.help: Review the two concentric bows around the antisolar point, secondary inside primary, with opposite colour ordering for normal dispersion.
